organization.short_description:
HPE Aruba Networking, based in Santa Clara, California, is a subsidiary of Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) that specializes in AI-powered networking solutions. Founded in 2002, the company focuses on providing secure and reliable connectivity for enterprises, schools, and government entities. With a revenue of approximately $3 billion and over 7,000 employees globally, HPE Aruba Networking operates as the "Intelligent Edge" business unit of HPE.

The company offers a comprehensive range of products and services, including Mobility-Defined Networks, Aruba Central for network management, CX Switches for switching solutions, and enterprise wireless options. Their solutions cater to various sectors, including healthcare, education, and small to medium businesses, ensuring high-performance networking tailored to the needs of each industry. HPE Aruba Networking aims to enhance productivity and reduce operational costs through automated performance optimization and security measures.
